title: Zcash 2019: inflation hiding in the proof system
summary: A cryptographic flaw in Sapling allowed undetectable counterfeiting of ZEC. No wallet was hacked; the math permitted minting outside the transparent supply schedule. We explain the class without reconstructing a forge.

case.name: Zcash Sapling inflation vulnerability (disclosed)
case.impact: Potential undetectable counterfeiting of shielded ZEC; fixed in network upgrade before public detail
